issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for Book.genres: the problem statement requires genres to be an optional array of Genre ([Genre]?). The solution implementation declares Book.genres as a non-optional array (let genres: [Genre]) in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift, while the Client implementation in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift treats genres as optional (uses `guard let genres = book.genres`) and constructs a Book with `genres: nil`. This contradiction will cause a compilation error and will confuse students about the intended type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Book.genres optional to match the problem statement and Client usage. Change the declaration in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to: `let genres: [Genre]?`. Verify and update any other occurrences if necessary (the provided Client already treats genres as optional). Ensure the template/test expectations also require an optional genres property.
